name: andremoah-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by André Mota: tooling that closes loops AI-assisted coding leaves open.

plugins.name: code-expiry
plugins.description: Temporary code with an expiry date: date, surface and remove fallbacks, flags and shims from inside Claude Code.

plugins.name: feature-estimate
plugins.description: Impact map, risk flags and tiered effort estimate for a feature; guided setup builds an architecture map of your repos first.

plugins.name: legacy-spec
plugins.description: Spec an undocumented legacy system one context-sized unit at a time: cited rules, data model, glossary and open questions, progress kept on disk.

plugins.name: readme-sync
plugins.description: Keeps the functional README true to the code: maps sections to paths, flags stale sections, drafts the edit, fails CI on request.

plugins.name: tuneup
plugins.description: Tunes a Claude Code setup for token cost and accuracy from local usage data: measures, inventories, recommends community tools and rules with trade-offs, applies on approval, rechecks.
